summary: Sadot Group Inc. filed an 8-K reporting its entry into an Intellectual Property Purchase Agreement to acquire the TradeIQ predictive-intelligence software assets from Litial Ltd. The total consideration is $6,000,000, comprising a $50,000 cash component (two tranches of $30,000 and $20,000), 200,000 shares of common stock valued at $10.00/share ($2,000,000), and 3,950 newly issued Series C Non-Voting Non-Convertible Preferred shares with a $1,000 stated value ($3,950,000). The agreement includes customary reps, warranties, and indemnification. The board has not yet disclosed its recommendation or named advisors. Transaction structure uses a mix of cash and equity with a 90-day transition services period. Watch for closing conditions and any shareholder approval requirements.
